text:
jia: saw a sharp latency tail and throughput drop across a subset of hosts after the batcher rewrite deploy :grimacing:

matt: any quick numbers?

jia: 95th p50 -> p95 increased from 180ms -> 870ms on gpu-pool-3. throughput down ~35% on those nodes. KV prefix hit-rate tanked from 74% to 4.8% for tenant:search-index

anya: 4.8% wtf. Did the deploy touch cache config?

jia: deploy touched batching heuristic (smaller windows, aggressive coalescing) + we flipped kernel selection policy to 'handover' for queues > 32 tokens. suspect interaction.

profiling-bot: perf sample (host gpu-12):
```
kv_prefix_hitrate: 4.8
kv_evictions_per_min: 1200
batching_window_ms: 5 (was 20)
kernel_selected: int8-fallback (handed-over from auto-opt)
cpu-steal: 2%
```

ellie: logs show a flurry of prefix insertions with near-identical keys, TTLs only 30s. looks like prefix normalization changed: we used to canonicalize-smash, new batcher preserves raw request id prefixes.

matt: ah — so higher cardinality prefixes -> cache dilution. kernel handover changed timing so more requests hit cold cache and caused churn.

anya: any noisy tenants? tenant:search-index had a burst at 11:02 UTC, correlated with spike.

ops-bot: detected autoscale events on pool gpu-pool-3 during the window, created 6 new shards, rebalanced kv shards.

jia: hypothesis: batching rewrite reduced coalescing, increased unique prefix combos per second; kernel handover moved some requests to int8 path which doesn't use the optimized KV prefetch, so we lost effective priming.

matt: plan: roll back batching change to previous window size (20ms) and revert kernel handover flag on gpu-pool-3. also increase kv ttl to 120s temporarily to re-prime.

ellie: I pushed a revert PR for batcher (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4521) and a kernel toggle patch.

profiling-bot: after rollback at 11:38 UTC:
```
kv_prefix_hitrate: 68.2
p95 latency down to 210ms
throughput back to baseline
kv_evictions_per_min: 130
```

jia: confirming steady, will run load tests to validate kernel heuristics. follow-ups: add unit test to ensure prefix canonicalization unchanged, add canary metrics for kernel path vs kv-prefetch hit correlation.

matt: good postmortem notes. thanks for quick triage :thumbsup:

anya: file a retro ticket and let's discuss long-term fix (batcher heuristics + kernel prefetch compatibility) in next runtime sync.

jia: creating ticket now: https://triage.internal/t/RED-8992

ops-bot: incident closed by jia
